gen.title: Checking temperature and moisture limits for climate zones

cards.stem: What temperature must the warmest month exceed in moist continental mid-latitude climates?
cards.quote: The average temperature of the warmest month is greater than 50°F (10°C), while the coldest month average temperature is less than 27°F (-3°C).

cards.stem: What temperature stays true for every month in tropical climates?
cards.quote: In these climates, all months have average temperatures greater than 64°F (18°C) and annual precipitation greater than 59".

cards.stem: What describes the warmest month in polar climates?
cards.quote: Polar climates have year-round cold temperatures, with the warmest month less than 50°F (10°C).
